description: Secure reference implementations for common DeFi patterns. Used by contrastive auditor to detect missing invariants.

patterns.name: ERC20 Payment via msg.sender
patterns.description: Secure pattern: only transfer tokens from msg.sender, no parameter injection
invariants: No parameter can override who pays
patterns.vulnerability_if_missing: If fromAddress is a parameter, attacker can drain any user who approved the contract

patterns.name: ERC20 Payment with Signature Verification
patterns.description: Secure pattern: verify signature proves user authorized the transfer
invariants: Nonce must be checked to prevent replay
Chain ID must be included for cross-chain protection
Token and amount must match the signed data
patterns.vulnerability_if_missing: If signature is not verified, attacker can forge authorization and steal tokens

patterns.name: Ownable Access Control
patterns.description: Secure pattern: critical functions restricted to owner
invariants: Only owner can call critical functions
patterns.vulnerability_if_missing: If onlyOwner is missing, anyone can call critical functions

patterns.name: Role-Based Access Control
patterns.description: Secure pattern: specific roles for specific actions
invariants: Admin role is separate from operational roles
patterns.vulnerability_if_missing: If roles are not enforced, unauthorized users can execute privileged actions

patterns.name: Reentrancy Guard
patterns.description: Secure pattern: prevent reentrant calls to state-changing functions
invariants: State changes before external calls (CEI pattern)
No nested calls to same function
patterns.vulnerability_if_missing: If reentrancy guard is missing, attacker can re-enter and drain funds

patterns.name: Slippage Protection
patterns.description: Secure pattern: minimum output amount check
invariants: User must specify minimum output amount
patterns.vulnerability_if_missing: If slippage protection is missing, MEV bots can front-run and steal value

patterns.name: Lending Health Factor Check
patterns.description: Secure pattern: check health factor before any collateral reduction
invariants: Health factor must remain above threshold after any action
Any action that reduces collateral must check health factor
Liquidation must be possible when health factor < 1
patterns.vulnerability_if_missing: If health factor is not checked, user can withdraw collateral and become undercollateralized

patterns.name: Liquidation Mechanism
patterns.description: Secure pattern: proper liquidation with incentives
invariants: Liquidation can only happen when health factor < 1
patterns.vulnerability_if_missing: If liquidation is not properly implemented, protocol can become insolvent

patterns.name: NFT Approval Restriction
patterns.description: Secure pattern: restrict who can be approved for NFT operations
invariants: Only authorized contracts can transfer NFTs
patterns.vulnerability_if_missing: If approval is not restricted, unauthorized users can transfer NFTs

patterns.name: Cross-Contract State Synchronization
patterns.description: Secure pattern: ensure state is consistent across contracts
invariants: Reverts must roll back all state
patterns.vulnerability_if_missing: If state is not synchronized, contracts can be in inconsistent states

patterns.name: Flash Loan Reentrancy Protection
patterns.description: Secure pattern: prevent flash loan attacks on state
invariants: Flash loan must be repaid in same transaction
State must not be manipulable during flash loan
patterns.vulnerability_if_missing: If flash loan is not properly guarded, attacker can manipulate state in single transaction

patterns.name: Upgradeable Proxy Pattern
patterns.vulnerability_if_missing: If upgrade is not protected, attacker can take over the contract

patterns.name: Oracle Price Feed Integration
patterns.description: Secure pattern: reliable price oracle usage
invariants: Price must be from trusted oracle
patterns.vulnerability_if_missing: If price is stale or manipulable, attacker can exploit pricing errors
